title: German Chicken Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish that combines the flavors of Germany with the simplicity of a casserole. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the sliced sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the cooked sausage from the skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked sausage, onion, and chicken breast.
In a separate bowl, mix together the crumbled bread and melted butter.
Add the bread mixture to the chicken mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Let the casserole rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.
